sources.label: Official Desigual women's size guide (Tops, letter sizes, cm)

audit: Old /help/size-guide.html URL 404s. Used the Tops letter table (Europe XS-XXL). Ranges replace single values and XXL is added. EU numbers removed: the letter table's Europe row is letters; numeric tops (Spain 36-46 = UK 10-20) are a separate table that differs slightly from L up, not stored. US row is letters and one size off the European letter, as printed (EU S = US XS). Stored UK 8 XS 82/66/88 -> 81-84/63-66/89-92; UK 12 M 91/75/97 -> 89-92/71-74/97-100; UK 16 XL 103/87/109 -> 99-104/81-86/107-112.
